claims: As of March 12, 2026, the average U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rate is approximately 6.11%.
As of March 12, 2026, the average U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rate is up from 6.00% last week.
The U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rate peaked at 7.8% in October 2023.
As of March 12, 2026, some lenders offer U.S. 30-year fixed mortgage rates between 5.75% and 6.35% depending on points and fees.
As of March 12, 2026, the average U.S. 15-year fixed mortgage rate is around 5.50%.
As of March 12, 2026, U.S. 5/1 adjustable rate mortgage rates are in the mid-to-high 5% range.
